cells.gaps: Nothing found names social protection systems exchanging data, or says there is none. Ley 5/2026 creates a social registry that other bodies must supply on request; no link is built.
cells.note: Ley 5/2026 creates the Registro Único Social and obliges other bodies to supply it data; a legal duty is not a link contracted, built or piloted, as with the DRC's decrees. No row is held, so no stage.
